blocks.text: Pesticides aise chemicals hain jo keeron (insects), jari-bootiyon (weeds) ya phaphoond (fungi) jaise nuqsan deh jaandaron (pests) ko maarne ya qaboo karne ke liye use hote hain. Pesticides fasalon ko nuqsan se bachate hain, food loss (khuraak zaya hona) rokte hain aur khuraak ki stable supply (lagataar milna) yaqeeni banate hain. Jis target pest ko yeh nishana banate hain, us ke lihaz se inhein teen qismon mein baanta jata hai: insecticides (keeron ke liye), herbicides (jari-bootiyon ke liye) aur fungicides (phaphoond ke liye).

Insecticides woh chemicals hain jo keeron ke nervous system (nason ka system) ko target kar ke unhein qaboo karte hain. Organophosphates ya neonicotinoids jaise kai modern insecticides neurotoxins (nervous system ke liye zehr) ka kaam karte hain; yeh keeron ka nervous system kharab kar dete hain, jis se keere ko paralysis (falij) ho jata hai aur woh mar jata hai. Reports ke mutabiq neonicotinoids ka talluq shehed ki makhiyon (honeybees) mein “Colony Collapse Disorder” (makhiyon ke chhatte ka achanak khatam ho jana) se hai, jo duniya bhar mein pollination (phoolon ka zar aik phool se doosre tak pohanchna) ke liye khatra hai.

Herbicides woh chemicals hain jo unwanted (na-chahe) aur competitive (fasal se muqabla karne wale) paudon ko control karte hain; inhein weeds (jari-bootiyan) kehte hain. Kuch herbicides enzyme ko kaam se rok dete hain (enzyme inhibition) aur zaroori amino acids banne nahi dete. Jab ke kuch herbicides electron transport ko bigaar kar weeds ko photosynthesis karne se rok dete hain.

Fungicides fungus (phaphoond) ke cells ki cellular integrity (salamati) ko target kar ke use maarte hain. Yeh fungus ki cell membrane (cell ki jhilli) mein ergosterol synthesis (banna) rokte hain; stable (mazboot) membrane ke baghair fungus ka cell leak hone (risne) lagta hai aur mar jata hai. Sab se aam misalein triazoles aur strobilurins hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab zinc phosphide ko aam fungicides mein ginti hai, lekin zinc phosphide rodenticide (chuhe maarne ki dawa) hai, fungicide nahi. Neez sirf kuch fungicides (jaise triazoles) ergosterol banne ko rokte hain; strobilurins fungus ke cells mein energy banne ka process rokte hain.

Modern food development programs mein pesticides bohat ahem (pivotal) role ada kar rahe hain. Yeh paudon ko pests aur bimariyon se bachate hain aur fasalon ki paidawar barhate hain. Yeh epidemics (wabaon) ka khatra kam karte hain aur insaani sehat bhi behtar karte hain. Yeh duniya bhar mein food security (sab ke liye kaafi khuraak) aur stability (istehkaam) mein bhi hissa dalte hain.

Pesticides sehat par adverse effects (bure asar) bhi daal sakte hain, kyunke kuch carcinogenic (cancer paida karne wale) aur neurotoxic hain. Faidemand keere, parinde aur aquatic organisms (paani ke jaandaar) bhi pesticides se affect ho sakte hain. Kheton se beh kar aane wala paani (runoff) water sources (paani ke zakheeron) ko contaminate (ganda) kar sakta hai aur aquatic organisms ko nuqsan deta hai. Pesticides non-target species (jin jaandaron ko maarna maqsad nahi) ko bhi nuqsan de sakte hain, jaise pollinators (maslan shehed ki makhiyan), jo bohat si fasalon ki pollination mein ahem kirdar ada karte hain. Waqt ke saath pests kuch pesticides ke khilaf immunity (mazahmat) paida kar lete hain, aur woh pesticides kam effective ho jaate hain. Phir humein zyada toxic (zehreele) pesticides use karne parte hain, jo environment (mahol) aur sehat ke liye mazeed masail paida kar sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Pesticides ke istemal ka aik faida aur aik khatra batayein.
blocks.explanation: Faida: fasalon ko bachate aur paidawar barhate hain (food security). Khatra: maslan shehed ki makhiyon jaise non-target jaandaron ko nuqsan, paani ki gandagi, ya pests mein immunity (mazahmat).

items: Insecticides nervous system, herbicides amino acids ya photosynthesis, fungicides cell membrane (ergosterol) par asar karte hain.
Nuqsan: cancer aur nervous system ka khatra, makhiyan, paani ki gandagi, pests ki immunity.
